prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one close-up evidence photograph for a Taiwanese folk-horror game, landscape3:2. Keep important object well exposed and complete in frame. Repeated scratched Traditional Chinese phrase '都出來了' partly visible. On floor a rusty tin with FIVE dried red marker pens and FOUR partly overlapping old group photographs with messy red ink face defacement; keep tiny photo faces indistinct. No people or injuries. Layered palmprint sizes and red pens tell story of coerced silence. CRITICAL ART DIRECTION: This must be a frightening NIGHT-TIME location photograph, NOT a clean studio product shot or daytime illustration. Background falls into deep near-black darkness, only a narrow off-camera FLASHLIGHT beam with faint dying candle spill reveals the evidence. Surroundings ancient, neglected, water-damaged, cracked wood, mold, cobwebs, grime, realistic soot. Low-key cold desaturated green-black shadows, dirty muted amber highlights. Claustrophobic, unsettling horror-film realism, fine believable materials. No sunshine, bright window, white studio backdrop, glossy showroom, excessive fog hiding clues, or comic illustration.
